title: VTC Elections — Tombstones — Show — payload
description: A member reads what the community keeps of an election on a deleted board — its tombstone — to check a receipt against the board heads the community kept. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
Checkpoint.description: A board head the community read from the ballot box and kept, with the ballot box's signed document that carried it.

document.description: The ballot box's signed voting/board/head `#response` document whose payload carries `head`, kept whole and exactly as received — proof included — so anyone can verify it against the ballot box's DID without trusting the community.

Response.title: VTC Elections — Tombstones — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/elections/tombstones/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/elections/tombstones/show/0.1#response.

manifestDigest.description: The SHA-256 multihash of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization of the election's manifest, as registered. Every cast was bound to it.

ballotBox.description: The DID of the ballot box the election was registered with, whose signature each checkpoint's document carries.

checkpoints.description: The board heads the community kept, oldest first; the last is the final head once voting closed.

deletedAt.description: When the board the election was opened on was deleted.

removeAt.description: When the community removes this tombstone. Absent: kept for ever.
